description:
(Anti)proton spectra in γ+Au. The proton and antiproton mT spectra in γ+Au
processes selected from Au+Au collisions at √sNN = 54.4 GeV. Solid curves represent fits to
the spectra with the L´evy function. There is an additional 6% global uncertainty not included
in the figure. See text for details.
name: Figure S1
